questions.explanation: Studying these prescribed texts equips students with deep literary analysis skills, understanding theme, style, and characterisation within Hausa literature.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira babban bikin da ake yi domin murnar girbi ko wani lokaci na musamman a al'adar Hausawa, wanda ke tattare da wake-wake da nishadi?
questions.explanation: Kalankuwa is a traditional communal festival marked by singing and entertainment, often associated with harvest or seasonal celebration.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace muhimmiyar rawa ce bukukuwan addini irinsu takutaha ke takawa a al'adar addini da al'umma na Hausawa?
options: Ana daukarta a matsayin wani lokaci/biki na addini da al'ada wanda ke da alaka da ibada da tunawa a al'ummar Hausawa
Ba ta da wata alaka da addini ko al'ada
Ana amfani da ita ne kawai wajen wasannin motsa jiki
Take ce ta zamani da ba ta da tushe a al'ada
questions.explanation: Such religious observances are regarded as periods of worship and remembrance deeply integrated into Hausa religious and cultural life.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene bambanci tsakanin bikin addini kamar Sallah da wasannin nishadi na gargajiya kamar Dambe a al'adar Hausawa?
options: Bikin addini yana da alaka kai tsaye da ibada da koyarwar Musulunci, yayin da wasannin nishadi kamar Dambe suka fi mayar da hankali kan fasaha da wasan gargajiya
Su biyun iri daya ne ba tare da bambanci ba
Dambe wani bangare ne na sallar Idi
Sallah ba ta da wata alaka da addini
questions.explanation: Religious festivals like Sallah are directly tied to Islamic worship, whereas recreational traditions like Dambe focus on skill and entertainment rather than religious observance.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace muhimmiyar rawa ce kokawa (traditional wrestling) ke takawa a wasu al'ummomin Hausawa masu zaman gona?
options: Ana amfani da ita wajen nuna karfi da jarumtaka, musamman bayan lokacin girbi a matsayin nishadi na al'umma
Ana amfani da ita wajen koyar da lissafi
Ba ta da wata alaka da rayuwar noma
Ana yin ta ne kawai a birane na zamani
questions.explanation: Traditional wrestling showcases strength and bravery and is commonly celebrated as post-harvest communal entertainment in farming communities.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban dalilin da ya sa ake gudanar da bukukuwan farauta (hunting festivals) a wasu al'ummomin Hausawa na gargajiya?
options: Domin bikin nasarorin da mafarauta suka samu tare da nuna godiya ga al'ada da yanayi
questions.explanation: Hunting festivals celebrate hunters' achievements and express gratitude to tradition and nature, an occupational cultural practice among some Hausa communities.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausawa, wace irin wasa ce yara suke yi da dare a lokacin hutu, wadda ta kunshi wake-wake da tafiya gida-gida?
options: Tashe (wasan kade-kade da wake-wake na yara da matasa, musamman a lokacin azumi)
questions.explanation: Tashe is a traditional nighttime performance involving children and youth singing and moving from house to house, especially during the Ramadan period.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene alakar sana'ar kamun kifi da al'adun gargajiya na wasu al'ummomin Hausawa da ke zaune kusa da koguna?
options: Ba ta da wata alaka da al'ada
Ana amfani da ita ne kawai wajen kasuwanci na zamani
Tana da alaka da bukukuwan gargajiya na godiya da nishadi bayan girbin kifi, wanda ke karfafa hadin kan al'umma
Ana yin ta ne kawai a lokacin fari
questions.explanation: Fishing among riverine Hausa communities is linked to traditional festivals of gratitude and communal entertainment following a successful catch.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace muhimmiyar rawa ce sarauta ta gargajiya (traditional emirate/chieftaincy) ke takawa wajen shirya manyan bukukuwa kamar Hawan Sallah?
options: Ba ta da wata rawa a shirya bukukuwa
Tana kawai halartar biki a matsayin baki
Tana adawa da gudanar da irin wadannan bukukuwa
Tana jagorantar shirye-shiryen biki, gami da hawan doki da liyafofin gargajiya, domin nuna daukaka da al'ada
questions.explanation: Traditional rulership leads the organisation of major festivals such as Hawan Sallah, including the ceremonial horse-riding procession and traditional receptions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban bambanci tsakanin bikin suna da bikin aure a al'adar Hausawa dangane da abin da ake bikin?
options: Su biyun bikin iri daya ne ba tare da bambanci ba
Bikin suna ana yin sa ne kawai a lokacin girbi
Bikin aure ana yin sa ne kawai ga sarakuna
Bikin suna ana yin sa ne domin bai wa jariri suna, yayin da bikin aure ke murnar hadewar ma'aurata biyu
questions.explanation: A naming ceremony formally names a newborn child, while a wedding celebrates the union of two people in marriage, distinct occasions with different purposes.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban darasin da za a iya koya daga yadda al'adun gargajiya na Hausawa (kamar kalankuwa, dambe, da bukukuwan girbi) ke ci gaba da wanzuwa a zamanin yau?
options: Al'adu gargajiya ba su da wata amfani a zamani na yau
Ya kamata a manta da al'adun gargajiya baki daya
Al'adu gargajiya suna hana ci gaban al'umma
Al'adun gargajiya suna iya rayuwa tare da zamani, suna karfafa hadin kai da asalin al'umma ko da yake lokaci ya sauya
questions.explanation: The continued practice of traditions like kalankuwa and communal festivals shows that cultural heritage can coexist with modernity while still reinforcing community bonds and identity.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ka'idar sakin layi (paragraphing), me ya kamata a yi idan an sauya zuwa wani sabon batu daban a cikin rubutu mai tsawo?
options: A ci gaba da rubuta dukkan batutuwa a sakin layi guda ba tare da rabewa ba
A fara sabon sakin layi domin nuna canjin batu ko tunani
A maimaita jimlar farko ta sakin layin da ya gabata
questions.explanation: Good paragraphing practice requires starting a new paragraph whenever the writer shifts to a new idea or topic, helping the reader follow the structure of the text.
